repos_data.description: CCXT for prediction markets. PMXT is a unified API for trading on Polymarket, Kalshi, and more.

Oracle3: open-source trading engine and MCP server for prediction markets. Finds fee-adjusted no-arbitrage violations across related event contracts and trades them live on Kalshi, Polymarket and Solana, or on paper, under pre-trade risk limits. 13 MCP tools, JSON CLI, agent skills, 600+ tests.
A self-improving weather forecasting & trading agent, in public.
Let any AI agent (Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini) paper-trade on CoinRithm with a key you mint and control. Hosted MCP, local MCP, OpenAPI, skill + prompts.

Python MCP server for ParlayAPI sports odds and props. Public discovery needs no key; account data uses your own key. Includes signup, login-email, checkout-link and preference actions. MIT code; API data redistribution rights are not included.

Hosted MCP server for Kalshi & Polymarket. Free, no key: NFL prop board, Kalshi vs Polymarket gaps, Kalshi weather board, 15-min crypto & metals, perps, Fed odds, Senate map, NHL, NBA, EV/Kelly. 44 tools, 37 free. Docs: predictionmarketspicks.com/mcp
